title: KP governor rules out talks with 'anti-state elements' after two police killed in Karak
detail: Governor Faisal Karim Kundi said there would be no negotiations or concessions for groups that do not accept the Constitution, and that decisive action against terrorism is the way to restore peace. He spoke after visiting the families of CTD DSP Imranuddin Khan and Constable Kazim Jan in Charsadda, who were killed in an operation against terrorists in Karak on Thursday. Kundi said the Centre would provide police with weapons and funds, and noted that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif had announced a Rs160 billion package for the province.
